$comment: Both Linux legs, compared with the release job's own runner: the same hosted image and tools, and the
Go toolchain release.yml links the archives with, set up there the same way.
The macOS leg, which the release job cannot resolve on its own runner: the platform and the exact Go
toolchain are pinned; the image version is recorded and not compared.
Every job of ci.yml is required on a push to main; none is skipped there. The four release steps are
left out of the Runner legs by ci.yml and run in Release contents, so each leg lists what it runs.
